allow:
Bash(performed"\) when a folder is in a transitional sync state. Previously
this bubbled up unhandled, causing VS to pause in debug mode and the
scan to fail in release.

Changes:
- Added EnumerateWithRetryAsync\(\) helper that retries a filesystem
  enumeration up to 3 times \(500ms apart\) on the specific Box Drive
  transient error before recording a recoverable ScanError and returning
  an empty list so the scan continues
- Added IsBoxDriveRetryError\(\) to identify the error by HResult
  \(0x800704D5\) or message content for robustness
- Both subdirectory and file enumeration in ScanDirectoryRecursiveAsync
  now use EnumerateWithRetryAsync instead of raw Task.Run + ToList\(\)
- Retries are logged at Warning level; final failures are recorded in
  ScanResult.Errors as BoxDriveError and the directory is skipped cleanly
